# QuizFlow AI

> AI funnel builder for TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram Ads. Build lead gen, product recommendation, qualification, and application funnels for paid social in minutes.

QuizFlow AI helps creators, media buyers, ecommerce brands, and agencies replace static landing pages with AI-generated funnels optimized for paid social advertising.

## Pages

- [Home](https://quizflow.ai/): Product overview, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, and how it works.
- [Sign in](https://quizflow.ai/login): Account login (private).
- [Dashboard](https://quizflow.ai/app): Authenticated workspace (private).
